items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A concert that was dedicated to Thelonious.

ctx.x: Okay. So you took wings at four.

That happened sometimes, too. Of course I had one like that. I had one girl who’d bring her child to the class. And one day, you know the child would be standing there, and one day I’d just say, “do you what you’re doing here?” She said – she shook her head, said, “yes” and she sat down there and she played the thing like she’d be playing it all the time. You know, and she ended up – she ended up starting out a concert at Lincoln Center, playing Pannonica, a Monk song. A concert that was dedicated to Thelonious.
